content: {"reasoning":"Authorization was required but missing, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review; a medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted. No correctable claim error or requested information supports another submission. CO-197 assigns the denied balance to provider contractual liability, and the plan’s 20% coinsurance alone does not establish patient liability for this denial, so the uncollectible balance should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
